title: ENIGMA
description: Minecraft modpack made by ENIGMA, a school video game club.
body:
Enigma is a modpack built for players who love creativity, adventure, and discovery. It expands Minecraft into a living, breathing world where exploration, engineering, and survival blend seamlessly.

Built around the Create mod and its expansions (Create Deco, Slice & Dice, Enchantment Industry, and Interiors), Enigma lets you design intricate machines, automate production, and craft stunning builds filled with moving parts and mechanical life.

Adventure fans will find a completely reimagined world — with Oh The Biomes We’ve Gone adding lush, diverse environments, and YUNG’s Better Structures overhauling temples, strongholds, and ruins for deeper exploration. New foods and farming systems from Farmer’s Delight Refabricated, Ender’s Delight, and My Nether’s Delight enrich survival with flavorful depth.

For builders and decorators, mods like Supplementaries, Sophisticated Storage, and Create Deco open endless design possibilities. You’ll find new blocks, decorations, and tools to bring every idea to life.

Whether you’re restoring ancient ruins, building an automated factory, simply surviving in a vibrant, mysterious world or sharing adventures with friends through Simple Voice Chat, Enigma offers the freedom to play your way. Every addition has been chosen to make the world richer, your builds smarter, and your journey more immersive.

Step into Enigma, and rediscover Minecraft as a world of wonders waiting to be built.
